root_cause.text: The null_blk driver did not release the configfs item references taken when creating fault injection child config groups (timeout_inject, requeue_inject, init_hctx_fault_inject) during device removal, leading to a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "the references taken to these fault-config configfs items are not released" and the patch adds `nullb_del_fault_config()` which calls `config_item_put()` on each fault config group item inside `nullb_group_drop_item()`. The kmemleak backtrace confirms allocations from `config_item_set_name` during `fault_config_init`.
